review_scope: Independent statistical and report review before full conditional and augmented-model completion; source and saved outputs inspected without rerunning unchanged tests.
passed_checks: No repeated allele-peptide pairs are invented as replicates; numerical noise ceiling is explicitly unavailable.
Zeros are not asserted to be synthetic padding or unmeasured solely from their numerical value.
All four joint pseudosequence mappings and canonical prior selection are distinguished.
Six of seven originally named clamp positions already present in pseudosequence is reported.
Raw replicate noise-ceiling unavailability is marked on correlation figures.
Fold-local means, PWMs, feature scaling, and unsupported LOAO categorical/PWM predictions are handled correctly.
Average ranks handle ties; constant predictions operationally score zero only with at least three valid rows and variable targets; missing predictions remain unavailable.
All and positive-only metrics are separately reported, with macro and size-weighted aggregation.
Partial full-data LOAO runs are excluded from final aggregate results.
Structural decoder official equivalence, causality, immutable contexts, and incremental cache alignment passed independent tests.
Assembly decision uses a label-free predeclared score-stability criterion and is not described as establishing molecular equivalence.
Conditional-independent gap is not interpreted as proof of biological positional independence.
No gain is not interpreted as proof that representations contain identical information.
Bootstrap intervals are explicitly descriptive and omit training-seed uncertainty and related-allele dependence.
Report builder now reads actual structural PNG directory and correct audit anchor figure filename.

final_narrative_requirements.evidence: B*27:05 shared ensemble P2 favors L, with R probability 0.1128, versus 0.8741 in smoothed empirical high-stability motif. Matching template raises R to 0.4640, yet positive-only kinetic Spearman is 0.0929.
final_narrative_requirements.required_interpretation: Report failed shared-template anchor recovery and partial matching-template recovery. Motif agreement is not sufficient evidence of kinetic prediction.

final_narrative_requirements.evidence: Matching template improves positive-only Spearman versus non-native ensemble in four of five tested alleles. A*03:01 worsens to -0.0901 from +0.0456. Across these five, means are 0.1388 matching and 0.0607 non-native.
final_narrative_requirements.required_interpretation: This limited descriptive control does not universally validate shared threading or native-template superiority.

final_narrative_requirements.evidence: Observed-residue mean log probability peaks at P2 and P9, but predicted motif entropy is lowest at P3 (2.8591 bits), versus P2 3.1778 and P9 3.2301.
final_narrative_requirements.required_interpretation: Observed residues are best supported at P2/P9, yet predicted specificity is strongest at P3; the diagnostics only partly recover canonical anchor behavior. Observed-residue log probability and distribution entropy measure different properties, so do not describe the anchor pattern as wholly absent.

final_narrative_requirements.evidence: Positive-only macro Spearman falls from 0.1218 to 0.0388. Original/shuffled score Spearman is 0.7719.
final_narrative_requirements.required_interpretation: HLA context influences the scores. This does not by itself establish calibrated allele specificity, and scrambling is an out-of-distribution perturbation.

final_narrative_requirements.evidence: Full independent per-row template/order score SD: mean 0.30737, median 0.29701, 5th-95th percentiles 0.13810-0.51271 log-probability units per residue.
final_narrative_requirements.required_interpretation: Include numerical spread for both modes once complete, not only a statement that arrays were saved. This is model sensitivity, not experimental uncertainty.

final_narrative_requirements.evidence: At review time, full conditional scoring and augmented baselines are still running.
final_narrative_requirements.required_interpretation: Regenerate aggregation and structural analysis only after final archives exist; report zero-shot structural score, baseline, and baseline plus features on all and positive-only rows. Do not carry the interim two-mode structural summary into the final report.

final_narrative_requirements.evidence: Representations use deterministic but representation-specific initialization seeds, and extra input dimensions change first-layer parameter counts.
final_narrative_requirements.required_interpretation: Describe gains as fixed-budget single-run empirical differences rather than proof of orthogonal structural information.

final_narrative_requirements.evidence: For current fully covered structural predictions, LOAO macro correlations include 75 alleles; random includes 74 all / 73 positive-only; peptide-disjoint includes 71 for both subsets.
final_narrative_requirements.required_interpretation: Do not interpret numerical split-score differences alone as the magnitude of leakage; held-out observations and eligible allele populations differ.
